correctness.rationale: Exact P5 hazard expansion, conditional Poisson splitting, memoryless continuation and finite-horizon coupling yield the stated offspring PGF. The PGF has the exact fixed point lambda/c when supercritical. A uniform absorbing-step bound controls first-passage times at each fixed K, and G double prime equals 2*kappa at criticality, so the lattice local CLT and Dwass identity yield the stated coefficients. Numerical checker corroborates the formulas but is not used to prove them.

value.rationale: The deterministic threshold of the motivating chain leaves the one-founder probability unanswered. Exact first-passage coupling makes that question mathematically precise. The cancellation to 1-1/R, despite correlated reproduction and parent survival, and the contrasting kappa-dependent critical occupation amplitude are natural, interpretable structural properties of this specified social dynamical model. General branching theorems themselves are openly credited.
